items.title: Closed gradients satisfy weighted compact-test integration by parts

source.anchor: Appendix C.1 closed-gradient/density and conditional Poincare route; background Kolesnikov–Milman1310.2526v7§2.5
source.attribution: Samplinglib's explicit Euclidean analytic prerequisite to the proof route of Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang; not a quotation or a claim to have proved Lemma B.1.

items.statement: Both φ⟨G,v⟩ and u(D_vφ−φD_vW) are μ-integrable, and their integrals have opposite signs. This holds for every graph-closure pair of the same operator D, not just for its original smooth core.
assumptions: E is any finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma algebra, including dimension zero. W:E→R is C1 and exp(-W) is integrable for Euclidean volume; μ=volume.tilted(-W) is the actual normalized Gibbs law.

D is a given closable partial real-linear map from scalar L²(μ) to vector L²(μ). Its original graph is exactly the pairs represented μ-almost everywhere by (f,∇f) for smooth compactly supported f. This is the interface already proved by WeightedGradient, not an assumed integration-by-parts formula.
(u,G) belongs to the graph of D.closure. The test φ:E→R is C1 with compact support and v is any constant vector. No differentiability of the chosen measurable L² representatives u or G is required.

obligations.label: Identify the same closed gradient by compact tests, including integrability

bindings.boundary: Weighted compact-test identity for the same closed gradient only. Not an unweighted distributional derivative, H2 regularity, a D*D operator core, noncompact Bochner extension, Poincare, score variance, macroscopic coercivity or a complete paper.

assumption_deltas.source: Source uses a conditional Euclidean Sobolev gradient and its closedness in the Poincare/density route.
assumption_deltas.lean: Any given closable exact smooth compact gradient graph for normalized exp(-W) volume.
assumption_deltas.reason: The same operator is supplied by an existing construction; the weak test identity is proved, not assumed.

assumption_deltas.source: Actual conditional potential comes from a C2 strongly convex V with proved normalization.
assumption_deltas.lean: C1 W and integrable exp(-W), no curvature bound.
assumption_deltas.reason: Only the local product rule and compact tests enter; no curvature-dependent coercivity is claimed.

assumption_deltas.source: Kolesnikov–Milman background discusses compact weighted manifolds, boundary conditions and spectral properties.
assumption_deltas.lean: Only a full-space finite-dimensional weighted test identity, including dimension zero.
assumption_deltas.reason: Domain and conclusion boundary deliberately narrower than a full background regularity/spectral result; this is a prerequisite, not that theorem.

assumption_deltas.source: Representative choice, compact approximation and integrability are implicit in the analytic route.
assumption_deltas.lean: L2 equivalence classes, exact graph AE witnesses, both integrabilities, genuinely C1 compact test.
assumption_deltas.reason: No totalized derivative of an arbitrary L2 representative is used; compact support prevents any global score integrability premise.
